categories.summary: Scan-offset has a full round-trip: burn the swatch pattern, read each speed's best offset, type speed/offset pairs in Measured Scan Offset Apply, and 'Apply measured offsets' writes device.scanningOffsets (merged by speed) into the active DeviceProfile, later applied at compile. Material/Interval → saved material preset has NO automated path: the test-swatch→preset create path was removed (ADR-047); the Material Library wizard is the sole manual-entry authoring route.
